technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX 44.5) with early recovery signals (RSI rising, StochRSI cross-up, three white soldiers) but severely undermined by price trading below all major moving averages, bearish MACD, and below VWAP—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 37 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (13/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (392.0), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and deteriorating credit conditions create severely adverse macro backdrop for real estate; earnings in 37 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: ADX 44.5 confirms strong trend structure; three white soldiers + RSI rising + StochRSI cross-up signal early recovery momentum, with extreme fear (13/100) offering contrarian entry opportunity near support at 109.61.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trading below all major moving averages (50 SMA, 200 EMA), bearish MACD, below VWAP, Ichimoku below cloud, combined with crisis VIX (392), high credit spreads, rising dollar, and earnings event risk in 37 days create overwhelming headwinds that invalidate technical recovery signals.

decision.entry_rationale: While ADX 44.5 and three white soldiers signal trend structure with extreme fear offering contrarian opportunity, price remains below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and Ichimoku below cloud—insufficient confluence for entry.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis VIX (392), deteriorating credit spreads, rising dollar, and earnings event in 37 days create severe macro headwinds that could invalidate technical recovery signals and trigger sharp reversal.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 4 open Real Estate positions; adding CPT would increase sector concentration without fundamental or macro justification.
